column1: # Warp alpha command mix for the R4 load bot (OBI-40). See loadbot/README.md.
# Format: <weight> TAB <step>[;<step>...]. Lines starting with # are comments.
# A multi-step entry is sent one step at a time, waiting for the prompt after
# each step. {peer} = another bot's character name, {n} = a random 1..999.
# Weights are relative (sum 100 here). Every entry starts and ends in the
# Entrance Hall, so bots stay in the peaceful start zone plus the NPC-free
# Edge of the Wood, and never meet the aggressive wolf.
